duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 30 seconds, or auto to let the model decide based on the prompt.

output_format.description: Output video format. 'mp4' is broadly compatible with browsers, mobile devices and media players. 'mov' targets professional post-production such as color grading, keying and compositing, but may not

resolution.description: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance, 1080p for high quality, 4k for highest quality.

bitrate_mode.description: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.

return_last_frame.description: If true, also return the last frame of the generated video as an image.

end_image_url.description: The URL of the image to use as the last frame of the video. When provided, the generated video will transition from the starting image to this ending image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TI

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Always "auto" for image-to-video

image_url.description: The URL of the starting frame image to animate. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC, HEIF. Max 30 MB.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated

codec.description: 'auto' uses the default video codec; US backend output is kept unchanged. 'H264' and 'H265' select H.264 and H.265 respectively.

draft.description: Generate a draft preview at 480p, overriding resolution. Returns a draft_id for completing the draft at 1080p or 4k within 14 days.

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the desired motion and action for the video.

end_user_id.description: The unique user ID of the end user.
